decisions.decision: Use an editorial warm-paper direction with dark ink typography and a restrained cobalt accent.
decisions.reason: The portfolio needs to feel confident and authored while keeping project screenshots central.

decisions.decision: Present every case inside a quiet browser frame and keep all case facts in one data module.
decisions.reason: Live work remains easy to scan, verify, and update.

decisions.decision: Use the real Telegram portrait as a compact editorial identity block in the hero.
decisions.reason: The portfolio should feel personal without competing with the large headline or case imagery.

decisions.decision: Use a 16:9 interactive case gallery with a live-site link and five real project screens per case.
decisions.reason: Screenshots stay uncropped, work can be explored in context, and every project gets the same proof-led treatment.

decisions.decision: Frame the portfolio through a marketing-led positioning section before the cases, with three restrained proof points.
decisions.reason: Valeriy's six years in marketing and leading-marketer role explain why the website work starts with audience, offer, and conversion rather than visuals alone.

decisions.decision: Adopt the selected Marketing is a Signal direction: expressive Unbounded typography, a dark-cobalt-coral-acid signal palette, strong borders, and poster-like project framing.
decisions.reason: The portfolio must be memorable and demonstrate Valeriy's visual confidence while retaining clear case evidence and a professional marketing focus.

decisions.decision: Use staged reveal, an animated signal ring, a continuous strategy-to-leads ticker, and tactile case hover motion as the motion language.
decisions.reason: Motion should demonstrate craft and guide attention without hiding content; all effects respect the reduced-motion preference.

decisions.decision: Evolve the hero into a kinetic interaction layer with type-in lines, cursor-responsive spatial motion, and magnetic contact actions.
decisions.reason: Valeriy wants the site itself to prove a higher level of web craft; motion remains functional by keeping the message, cases, and contact path readable.

decisions.decision: Use a continuous camera-dive transition: each major section begins distant and soft, then scales into its final surface in direct response to scrolling.
decisions.reason: The intended feeling is a Google Earth-style descent into the next layer of the site, not a separate overlay or a discrete card animation.
